exposure: Tenofovir disoproxil fumarate (TDF) use throughout pregnancy
cohort: The study included 562 mothers with chronic hepatitis B who received antiviral treatment throughout pregnancy at Beijing Ditan Hospital between January 2013 and December 2018.
finding: TDF and LdT treatments throughout pregnancy were equally effective in preventing mother-to-child transmission of HBV (0% MTCT rate in both groups) and showed similar safety profiles in mothers and infants.
birth_weight: Infant weight was measured and found to have no significant difference between groups.
gest_age: Gestational age was measured and found to have no significant difference between groups.
